# Omniide — Research & Engineering | Intelligent Systems & Medical Technology

> Omniide is an advanced research and engineering organization headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Omniide engineers autonomous software infrastructure, open-source AI developer tools, and breakthrough medical imaging operating systems.

## Primary Medical Flagship: Omni Cero (India's First DROC Software)

- Product Name: Omni Cero (Omni Cero DROC, Live Cero, Cero XVR)
- Category: Digital Radiography Operating Console (DROC), C-arm Fluoroscopy & Intraoperative Surgical Navigation
- Status: India's First DROC Software & India's First Multi-Brand DROC Software
- Primary URL: https://cero.omniide.com/
- Parent Company & Engineering Lab: Omniide (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India)
- Deployment Model: 100% Offline Windows Workstation (Zero Cloud Dependency, Total Air-Gapped Hospital Security, HIPAA/DISHA Compliant)
- Official Documentation & Demos: https://cero.omniide.com/

### What is Omni Cero DROC?
Omni Cero DROC is India's first DROC software and the country's first universal, multi-brand Digital Radiography Operating Console. In healthcare radiology, DROC (Digital Radiography Operating Console) is the mission-critical software workstation that interfaces directly with X-ray flat-panel detectors (FPD), synchronizes high-frequency generator exposure triggers, applies real-time image processing (edge enhancement, grid suppression, dynamic range compression), and transmits DICOM studies to hospital PACS and dry laser imagers.

Unlike legacy proprietary consoles that restrict clinics to a single expensive hardware ecosystem, Omni Cero provides plug-and-play driver integration across 11 global flat-panel detector manufacturers:
1. Varex Imaging (PaxScan series)
2. iRay Technology (Mars, Mercu, and wireless cesium iodide detectors)
3. Vieworks (VIVIX-S series)
4. DRTECH (EVS series with TRUVIEW II processing)
5. Rayence (Green Series Csl detectors)
6. Canon Medical Systems (CXDI wireless & tethered series)
7. CareRay (CareView series)
8. Carestream Health (DRX series)
9. Thales Group (Pixium detectors)
10. Teledyne DALSA (Xineos CMOS detectors)
11. PIXXGEN Corporation

### Real-Time Surgical & Fluoroscopic Imaging: Live Cero
- 30 FPS continuous fluoroscopy acquisition for surgical C-arms.
- Real-time Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) for vascular interventions.
- Multi-monitor dual-screen surgical display with live and reference roadmapping.
- Zero frame drops with sub-35ms ultra-low latency hardware pipeline.

### Intraoperative 3D Surgical Navigation: Cero XVR
- Neural 2D-to-3D registration aligning intraoperative 2D fluoroscopic X-rays with pre-operative 3D CT and MRI scans.
- Real-time tool pose tracking and sub-millimeter surgical trajectory verification for orthopedics, spine surgery, and interventional radiology.

## Developer Infrastructure: OmniIDE

- Name: OmniIDE
- Type: Autonomous AI Integrated Development Environment
- Status: Free and Open-Source AI IDE
- Website: https://omniide.com/
- Product Page: https://omniide.com/omni/
- GitHub: https://github.com/OMNI-IDE-in
- Download (Windows 10/11): https://github.com/nihannihu/Omni-IDE/releases

### OmniIDE Capabilities
- Omni-Agent: Autonomous coding loop (Plan -> Execute -> Verify -> Self-Heal) powered by Google Gemini API and Ollama.
- Self-Healing Terminal: Automatically intercepts compiler errors, syntax bugs, and runtime exceptions to patch and verify fixes in real time.
- Hardened Sandbox: Process-isolated execution environment ensuring host operating system safety.
- Zero Telemetry: Completely private, client-side execution with zero keystroke or code harvesting.
